title: RBAC Scoped Visibility (assignment-scoped rows)
summary: Assignment-scoped row-level visibility — a role sees only rows assigned to it, live role re-read server-side. Ships a pure filter/predicate helper plus an M:N assignment table pattern; composes with the defineAction() authorize hook (E323).

postInstall.description: Re-export the assignment schema from the Drizzle barrel so drizzle-kit picks up the table: add `export * from "./rbac-scoped-visibility/schema"` to lib/schema/index.ts. Without this, db:generate will not emit a migration for resource_assignees.
Generate the Drizzle migration for the resource_assignees table.
Apply the migration to your database.

Wire `hasFullVisibility` to your own permission matrix (e.g. `(role) => role === "admin"` or a call into `@/lib/permissions`), then call canSeeAssignedRow()/filterAssignedRows() from the query layer or a defineAction() `authorize` hook. See the install-rbac-scoped-visibility skill for the exact wiring against `getLiveRole()` (E323).
